The Chinese characters for Melissa

As a transliteration, Melissa is usually written 梅利莎 (Méi lì shā). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

梅
Méi
plum
利
lì
sharp, benefit
莎
shā
sedge, a plant

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Melissa carries the meaning “bee, honey”.

About the name Melissa

A Greek name meaning 'bee', and a nymph who cared for the infant Zeus.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “bee, honey”, a Melissa calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
